text.title: A/B Testing Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes by cycle length, power, SRM, significance, guardrails and practical significance to a rule in 01-core-rules.xml.

conclusion.verdict: decision=invalid-underpowered; extend or kill (no ship). Never cut the planned sample on a positive trend
decision=extend; the sample may be reached but the population is not representative until one full business cycle has run
decision=invalid-srm; investigate bucket leak; do not ship regardless of p-value
decision=kill or extend; CI spans zero
decision=kill; a guardrail regression blocks the ship regardless of the primary metric

branch.when: wilson_ci_low > 0 AND guardrail_regression == false AND effect < practical_floor

conclusion.verdict: decision=kill; significant but below the declared practical floor — not worth the implementation and maintenance cost

branch.when: wilson_ci_low > 0 AND guardrail_regression == false AND effect >= practical_floor

conclusion.verdict: decision=ship pending the named human's sign-off; close flag + record artefact

text.example: sample_size=24940 >= 24000 → elapsed 17 days → srm_chi_square_p=0.78 >= 0.001 → wilson_ci_low=0.041 > 0 → guardrails flat → effect above the practical floor → conclusion ship-needs-named-human → ship on sign-off.
